description: THP: normalise sshd / useradd / crontab syslog lines to the THP field contract

patterns: Failed password for (invalid user )?%{USERNAME:user.name} from %{IP:source.ip} port %{NUMBER:source.port:int}

script.description: set event.* from the message type
script.source: if (ctx.message == null) { return; } String m = ctx.message; Map ev = (ctx.event instanceof Map) ? ctx.event : new HashMap(); if (m.contains('Failed password')) { ev.put('category','authentication'); ev.put('outcome','failure'); ev.put('action','ssh_login'); } else if (m.contains('Accepted password') || m.contains('Accepted publickey')) { ev.put('category','authentication'); ev.put('outcome','success'); ev.put('action','ssh_login'); } else if (m.contains('new user: name=')) { ev.put('category','iam'); ev.put('action','user_created'); } else if (m.contains('BEGIN EDIT')) { ev.put('category','configuration'); ev.put('action','cron_modified'); } ctx.event = ev;
